channel.title: Microsoft 365 Message Center Archive
channel.description: Latest Microsoft 365 Message Center messages. Message Center posts vary by tenant; always use your tenant's Message Center as the source of truth.

item.title: MC1568702: Adding in app browsing control policies
item.description: Enterprise policies now control Copilot desktop app's built-in browser on Windows and Mac, covering security, privacy, content access, authentication, and permissions. Available worldwide, admins should enable browsing, align policies with existing governance, test with pilot users, and communicate changes. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: MC1568700: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Customize how citations are included when copying responses
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will add a customizable "Copy with sources" option by mid-December 2026, letting users choose whether to include citations when copying responses. It is enabled by default but can be turned off to copy text without citations. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1568699: Campaigns in SharePoint
item.description: SharePoint is introducing site campaigns, integrating Viva Amplify's campaign management directly into SharePoint for unified creation, distribution, and analytics of news posts. Available to both seeded and licensed Viva Amplify users, rollout begins mid-August 2026. No changes to existing Amplify campaigns or licensing.

item.title: MC1568697: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management-Introducing IRM Alert classification
item.description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management will introduce alert classification as True positive, Benign, or False positive to improve risk reporting and tuning. Rolling out from December 2026 to January 2027, it separates classification from alert status and updates alert actions. No configuration changes required; notify analysts accordingly.

item.title: MC920304: Microsoft Purview | Communication Compliance: Policy alerts improvements
item.description: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance will enhance policy alert customization, allowing admins to adjust alert frequency and recipients. Public preview starts October 2026, with general availability by mid-August 2027. Features include pseudonymized usernames, role-based access, and audit logs to support compliance and privacy.

item.title: MC1568568: Configure security key sign-in experience for display-based NFC readers
item.description: What and why: An improved security key sign-in experience is available on Windows 11 devices with display-based Near Field Communication (NFC) readers. A new on-screen indicator now shows where to tap your security key during sign-in. The indicator adjusts to the device's screen orientation, making it easier to locate the NFC reader. Rollout schedule:This improved sign-in experience and simpler appearance are available starting with the November 2026 Windows non-security update. Impact on your o...

item.title: MC1566260: Video creation from a prompt in Microsoft Clipchamp: now in Video Hub, with an upgraded experience coming
item.description: Video creation from a prompt in Microsoft Clipchamp has moved to Clipchamp Home with an upgraded experience coming by February 2027. Users access it via the Microsoft 365 app launcher. Existing projects remain accessible, no admin action is needed, and all other features stay unchanged.

item.title: MC1568439: Out-of-band hotpatch update addresses stop error 0x139 on Windows Server 2025
item.description: Microsoft has released a new Windows out-of-band (OOB) update today, November 25, 2026, to address an issue affecting a limited number of Windows Servers with Router Advertisement (RA) enabled that receive time-bound IPv6 routes. Affected devices might stop unexpectedly with stop error 0x139 (KERNEL_SECURITY_CHECK_FAILURE) when a route timer expires. This issue affects some Windows Server 2025 devices after installing the November 2026 Windows security hotpatch update. This non-security OOB upda...

item.title: MC1481313: Microsoft Purview | DLM: Legacy Teams retention policies that cover Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
item.description: Starting mid-January 2027, legacy Microsoft Teams retention policies will apply only to Teams data, excluding Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. Organizations must create separate retention policies for Copilot to maintain compliance. Existing Teams retention behavior remains unchanged, but action is required to cover Copilot data.

item.title: MC1562278: Microsoft Teams: Expanded Markdown support in the compose box
item.description: Microsoft Teams will expand Markdown support in the compose box, allowing users to write with visible syntax, use a Markdown toolbar, preview messages, and switch between Markdown and rich text. Public preview starts mid-December 2026; general availability begins mid-January 2027. No admin action needed.

item.title: MC1567320: Power Apps - Information about SharePoint thumbnails not rendering
item.description: We identified that changes made in relation to the retirement of SharePoint temporary authentication URLs communicated under MC1551122 may prevent thumbnails for SharePoint items from rendering in Power Apps. How does this affect me? SharePoint thumbnails displayed in your apps may not render. Other app functionality is not as affected. What action do I need to take? To restore missing SharePoint thumbnails, republish the affected app. After the app is republished, users who start or restart it...

item.title: MC1567263: Microsoft 365 Copilot: New notification option when pinning Copilot to the Windows taskbar
item.description: Microsoft 365 introduces an optional notification for admins pinning Microsoft Copilot to the Windows taskbar for selected groups. This notifies users with an Open Copilot action, enhancing communication and adoption. Rollout begins late November 2026. Admins must enable and schedule notifications via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

item.title: MC1567262: Microsoft 365 Backup: Up to 10-year recovery windows for SharePoint and OneDrive
item.description: Microsoft 365 Backup now allows configurable recovery windows up to 10 years for SharePoint and OneDrive, extending from the previous 2 years. Administrators can set recovery periods from 3 months to 10 years, while Exchange backup windows remain unchanged. No action is needed unless longer retention is desired.

item.title: MC1567261: OneDrive for Business: Bug fixes to ensure proper storage quota aligns with license limits
item.description: OneDrive for Business will fix a bug causing incorrect 1 TB storage quotas for users with certain license combinations. Starting January 2027, quotas will match the actual storage plan, potentially reducing some users' quotas. Organizations should review usage, adjust licenses, and prepare for possible read-only states.

item.title: MC1567258: Microsoft Teams for Android and iOS: Update to the latest app version to maintain file access
item.description: Update Microsoft Teams mobile to version 1416/1.0.0.2026151302 (Android) or 8.19.0 (iOS) by April 1, 2027, to maintain file access. Older versions will lose file functionality due to a shift to Microsoft Entra ID authentication replacing pre-authenticated URLs. Begin updates now.

item.title: MC1567253: Microsoft Viva Engage: Minimum operating system requirements changing for iOS and iPadOS
item.description: Starting January 2027, Microsoft Viva Engage app updates for iOS and iPadOS will require version 18 or later. Devices on iOS/iPadOS 17 or earlier can keep using current app versions but won't get updates or new features. No admin action needed; users should update their OS to continue receiving updates.

item.title: MC1567251: Windows Server 2028 is now available in public preview
item.description: What and whyWindows Server 2028 is now available in public preview. This release introduces security, storage, and management improvements and begins investments in hybrid intelligence to support AI inference on local infrastructure. The release includes a hardened Server Core configuration by default, a new security baseline, and Trusted Launch for virtual machines. item.description: (Updated 11-24-2026: KB5135557 has been updated with a Known issue section about compatibility issues affecting some third-party apps and devices using NTLM authentication, including authentication proxy servers and single sign-on (SSO) solutions.) What and why:New NTLM signing security improvements address CVE-2026-118737. item.title: MC1470424: Microsoft Viva Engage: New left navigation controls for collapsing, resizing, and managing favorites
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage is enhancing its left navigation with collapsible, resizable panes, unlimited favorites, and reorderable communities. These user-initiated features, available on web, Teams, and Outlook, will roll out globally by January 2027 with no admin action required. Users retain navigation structure and accessibility support.

item.title: MC1567225: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for Current Channel
item.description: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting November 24th, 2026 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. If you manage updates directly you can now download this la...

item.title: MC1530948: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection: Auto-labeling support for legacy Microsoft Office file formats
item.description: Microsoft Purview auto-labeling will support legacy Office files (.doc, .xls, .ppt) in SharePoint and OneDrive starting late November 2026. Existing policies need a minor edit and rerun to apply this. New policies support these formats automatically in both simulation and enforcement modes.

item.title: MC1567221: Power Platform admin center - Inventory data export (preview) stops December 1, 2026
item.description: As previously announced in the Power Platform admin center on October 30th, 2026, data export (preview) is deprecated and will be retired in phases. Inventory data export stops on December 1, 2026. Usage and environment data exports aren't affected by this change and continue to function as they do today. These will be retired at a later date, with advance notice. Data you've already exported is not affected by this change and will stay in your data lake. How does this affect me?Inventory data:...

item.title: MC1523085: Viva Insights: GitHub Copilot metrics will be on by default, and the public preview opt-in setting is being retired
item.description: GitHub Copilot metrics will be enabled by default in the Viva Insights Consumption dashboard starting mid-December 2026, retiring the public preview opt-in setting. No admin action is needed. Existing roles and permissions will control data access, and organizations should update documentation and inform relevant users.

item.title: MC1560920: Copilot video creation in Clipchamp Video Hub is now live in Frontier Public
item.description: Copilot video creation in Clipchamp Video Hub is now in public preview, enabling users to create and refine videos from documents and prompts using Copilot Credits. Admins must enable Anthropic models and configure spending policies. Videos export as MP4 with an AI watermark, and some preview limitations apply.

item.title: MC1532242: Microsoft Teams: Pinch to zoom in on shared screens
item.description: Microsoft Teams will add pinch-to-zoom on shared screens for easier viewing of details, rolling out worldwide from mid-November to late December 2026. This feature is enabled by default in all meetings, with no compliance issues identified. Organizations should update sharing policies and inform users.

item.title: MC1521613: Microsoft Teams: Streaming switchboard for NDI sources in meetings and events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a streaming switchboard for event producers to manage and stream up to eight NDI sources in meetings and events, rolling out worldwide from mid-November to mid-December 2026. Admins must enable NDI streaming, and users must activate production capabilities in Teams.

item.title: MC1478957: Microsoft 365 profile card: View dotted-line managers in the organization panel
item.description: The dotted-line manager feature in Microsoft 365 profile cards has been postponed indefinitely, with no new rollout date. Organizations should not expect this feature soon and need to update any related plans or communications accordingly. No preparation is required at this time.

item.title: MC1551148: [Outlook for iOS and Android] Copilot Chat in Outlook UX improvements
item.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook for iOS and Android is being updated with a refreshed, consistent design across Microsoft 365 apps, improved chat interface, prompts, and navigation. Rollout starts mid-December 2026, completing by late January 2027. No admin action or compliance concerns are required.

item.title: MC1556095: Plugins in PowerPoint for Microsoft 365 Copilot [Mac]
item.description: Plugins will be added to PowerPoint for Microsoft 365 Copilot on Mac, enhancing presentation capabilities. The rollout starts mid-November 2026 and completes by early December. Users can access plugins in Copilot, and admins can manage plugin access via the Microsoft 365 admin center. No compliance issues noted.

item.title: MC1550540: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot Workspaces is replacing standalone agent selection with agentic chat
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Workspaces will replace standalone agent selection (Researcher, Analyst, Designer) with an agentic chat that applies skills based on user requests. This simplifies workflows without losing capabilities. The change begins December 2026 in Frontier preview, with no admin action required. Separate agents remain in the Copilot app.

item.title: MC1558023: Microsoft Copilot in PowerPoint for Windows, Mac, and the web: Introducing new sales-focused skills
item.description: Microsoft Copilot in PowerPoint is introducing new sales-focused skills worldwide by late November 2026 to help sales teams prepare and refine presentations, work with sales data, and support sales conversations. No admin action is needed; users with licenses can enable these skills via the Sales plugin.

item.title: MC1559644: [Education] AI-powered teaching tools in OneNote Class Notebook
item.description: AI-powered Copilot teaching tools in OneNote Class Notebook help educators create personalized resources and interactive activities. Rolling out globally from mid-November to December 2026, these tools require no extra license and are managed via Copilot and Learning Activities settings. Educators should review AI-generated content before sharing.

item.title: MC1530595: Microsoft Copilot Feedback UX update
item.description: Microsoft Copilot is updating its thumbs-down feedback to include selectable categories and optional comments for clearer, actionable input. The rollout starts mid-November 2026, completing by early December, affecting users with Microsoft Entra ID and consumer accounts, excluding some environments. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1565967: New VDI solution for Omnissa on Mac
item.description: A new VDI optimization for Omnissa on Mac using a SlimCore-based media engine will enhance Microsoft Teams' quality, reliability, and performance. Rollout starts December 2026 to February 2027. Upgrade Horizon Client (2609.1+) and Teams (26304.1207.5384.858+) to benefit. No compliance issues noted.

item.title: MC1565964: Microsoft SharePoint Online: Classic publishing restrictions begin March 1, 2027
item.description: Starting March 1, 2027, SharePoint Online will block creation and activation of classic publishing sites and features, enforcing restrictions on custom scripting. New tenants face additional limits on classic pages. Administrators must update workflows and modernize pages before the rollout completes by October 2028.

item.title: MC1565960: Plan for Change: Updates to policy-related reporting in Microsoft Intune Data Warehouse
item.description: Starting January 4, 2027, Microsoft Intune Data Warehouse will update policy-related reporting collections, possibly causing changes in policy-status counts. Existing connections and schemas remain unchanged, and no action is required. Differences from Intune admin center reports may occur due to timing and aggregation.

item.title: MC1565959: Plan for Change: Updated web-based device enrollment experience for iOS/iPadOS
item.description: Microsoft Intune will update the web-based device enrollment experience for iOS/iPadOS in late January 2027, affecting only tenants using this method. No admin action is needed, but user guidance may be updated. This change precedes web-based enrollment becoming the default for iOS/iPadOS.

item.title: MC1472601: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint files under retention policies
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will enable admins to archive inactive SharePoint files under retention policies starting mid-January 2027. Archived files move to Microsoft 365 Archive, remain compliant and discoverable, and are excluded from Copilot indexing to improve response relevance. Admin configuration is required.

item.title: MC1325441: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Archive SharePoint files under retention
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will add an Archive option to retention policies, allowing admins to move inactive SharePoint files to Microsoft 365 Archive for cost savings while maintaining compliance and discoverability. Archived content is excluded from Copilot indexing. Rollout begins September 2026; admin configuration is required.

item.title: MC1261587: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Hard delete OneDrive and SharePoint files with priority cleanup workflow
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces a priority cleanup workflow allowing admins to hard delete specific OneDrive and SharePoint content, overriding retention policies with eDiscovery admin approval. Rolling out mid-August 2026 (preview) and early December 2026 (general availability), this feature requires explicit admin setup and supports compliance oversight.

item.title: MC1550542: Microsoft Teams: Updated recording and transcript access setting behavior for town halls and webinars
item.description: Microsoft Teams is updating the "Who has access to the recording or transcript" option for Events App town halls and webinars. Starting mid-January 2027, access will depend on the RecordingForTownhall or RecordingForWebinar settings, not AllowCloudRecording. No action is required.

item.title: MC1552394: Microsoft Viva Engage: Retiring the legacy live event creation option in Engage
item.description: Starting December 7, 2026, Microsoft Viva Engage will retire the legacy live event creation option. Organizers can no longer create legacy events but can still use Broadcast, Meeting, and Async Engage events. Existing legacy events will run as planned. Update organizers and documentation accordingly.

item.title: MC1519855: Microsoft Entra: Choose your own telephony provider now generally available
item.description: Microsoft Entra now generally supports Choose Your Own Telephony Provider (CYOT) and Bring Your Own Telephony Provider (BYOT) for SMS and voice authentication. Microsoft-provided SMS/voice retires February 1, 2027. Organizations must transition by then, prioritizing phishing-resistant methods and using telephony only when necessary.

item.title: MC1093912: Microsoft Outlook for iOS/Android: Improved Contacts with profile enrichment and duplicate management
item.description: Microsoft Outlook Mobile (iOS/Android) will unify duplicate contacts and enrich profiles with organizational info, improving contact views. The rollout starts mid-July 2025 and completes by March 2027, with no admin action needed. Users should update to the latest app version after rollout.

item.title: MC1446796: Migrate Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing before EWS deprecation
item.description: Exchange Web Services (EWS) deprecation starts October 1, 2026, affecting cross-tenant Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing. Microsoft 365 Cross-Tenant Access Policy will replace EWS by September-December 2026. Organizations must migrate to avoid service disruption; hybrid/on-premises scenarios have separate guidance. Rollout updates will be communicated.

item.title: MC1557760: Microsoft Teams: Registration capacity for town halls and webinars increases to 20,000
item.description: Starting December 2026, Microsoft Teams town halls and webinars registration capacity scales with attendee limits, up to 20,000 registrations per event. Teams Enterprise allows 3,000; Attendee Capacity Packs allow up to 20,000. Rollout occurs from mid-December 2026 to late January 2027. No action required.

item.title: MC1562279: Microsoft Teams: View files and conversations side by side
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable side-by-side viewing of files (PDF, Markdown, HTML) and their related conversations, enhancing context during review. This feature will roll out worldwide from late December 2026 to early January 2027 on Windows, Mac, and web, requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1562277: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in channels provides channel-wide context
item.description: Microsoft Teams is adding a channel-level Copilot feature allowing users to ask questions and summarize all posts and replies in a channel. Public preview starts December 2026 worldwide, with no action required. Copilot responses will include source citations and be available on Teams desktop and mobile.

item.title: MC1562275: Microsoft 365 Copilot app: New search experience for Microsoft 365 users without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license
item.description: Microsoft 365 is updating the Copilot app's search experience for users without a Copilot license, enabling modern search controls by default starting late November 2026. Users can toggle back to classic search. The update improves file and third-party content search while respecting access permissions.

item.title: MC1562272: New Contact Support Experience in Outlook for iOS, Android and Mac
item.description: A new Contact Support experience is rolling out in Outlook for iOS, Android, and Mac, aligning with the new Outlook for Windows. It uses the existing policy "Allow access to Contact Support in the new Outlook." Rollout starts late November 2026, completing by January 2027. No new policy needed; admins with disabled policies must redeploy.

item.title: MC1562269: Sync between Copilot desktop app and Microsoft Edge
item.description: Optional sync of passwords, personal info, settings, and browsing history between Copilot desktop app and Microsoft Edge will roll out worldwide in December 2026. Sync is account-based, opt-in, excludes payment info, and aims to improve user continuity and organizational productivity. Review governance before enabling.

item.title: MC1230457: Moderation approvals now available across Outlook apps
item.description: Moderation approvals in Exchange Online will use Actionable Messages adaptive cards across all Outlook clients starting March 2026, completing by November 2026. Dual-mode approvals end July 31, 2026. Moderators must have Microsoft 365 mailboxes. Actionable Messages must be enabled to prepare for this update.

item.title: MC1559642: Continuous interpreter visibility with pop out video in Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow users to pop out sign language interpreters' videos into a resizable, movable window for continuous visibility during meetings. Rolling out from December 2026 to January 2027 on Windows and Mac, this feature aids Deaf and hard-of-hearing users without affecting other participants' views.

item.title: MC1515303: Power Apps - Information regarding the end of support for Power Apps Developer Plan and unmanaged developer environments
item.description: The free Power Apps Developer Plan is being retired. As this plan works only in unmanaged developer environments, these environments are also being retired. Beginning with a regional rollout starting November 15, 2026, users will no longer be able to sign up for the plan or create new unmanaged developer environments. Developer environments that are Managed Environments and use paid licenses will not be affected by this retirement. How does this affect me? We have identified that your tenant has...

item.title: MC1515294: Power Apps – Feature retirement of Microsoft Dataverse for Teams: migrate before September 15, 2027
item.description: We are announcing the retirement of Microsoft Dataverse for Teams, the built-in subset of Dataverse capabilities in Microsoft Teams. Beginning with a regional rollout on November 15, 2026, customers will no longer be able to create new Dataverse for Teams environments. Existing Dataverse for Teams environments will continue to function until the start of a regional rollout on September 15, 2027. Please note that this change does not cancel your Microsoft 365 or Teams subscription, nor does it im...

item.title: MC1545694: Microsoft Entra: Updated passkey registration experience in My Sign-ins
item.description: Microsoft Entra is updating the passkey registration in My Sign-ins for Microsoft Authenticator users, adding a checkbox, updated link text, and guided steps to start registration. Rollout begins early December 2026, completing by end of December. Organizations should inform users and update guidance accordingly.

item.title: MC1540327: Action required: Prepare users who can’t use passkeys for SMS and voice retirement
item.description: Users relying solely on Microsoft-provided SMS/voice for MFA in sessions that don’t support passkeys must register alternative methods or configure customer-managed telephony before SMS/voice retirement begins February 1, 2027 (July 1 for admins/external users). Prepare early to avoid sign-in blocks.

item.title: MC1557754: Microsoft Copilot: Continue using models after reaching usage limits with Copilot Credits
item.description: Microsoft Copilot now allows continued use of models after license usage limits via usage-based billing (UBB) with Copilot Credits. Users see credit indicators and can choose between Auto mode or credit-consuming models. Admins manage access and spending through updated policies and controls. Rollout begins December 2026.

item.title: MC1535647: Microsoft Copilot app: Updates to Home and navigation
item.description: Microsoft Copilot app updates include a new Home with integrated Chat, Cowork, Projects, and Workspaces. Projects organize related tasks and files without storing content, available on major platforms. Workspaces replace Notebooks for team collaboration. Rollout starts late October 2026; licensing and billing configurations affect access.

item.title: MC1561862: Run Python code as a workflow step
item.description: We are announcing the ability to use the Code node to run Python as a step in a workflow for logic that expressions and connectors cannot handle in Copilot Studio. This feature will reach general availability on December 1, 2026. How does this affect me? Makers can add Python steps to workflows for data transforms, file parsing and conversion (e.g. PDF to text, CSV, or XML), and calls to APIs that don't have a connector. item.title: MC1561859: Generate documents from the Agent node in workflows
item.description: We are announcing the ability to generate documents from the Agent node in workflows within Copilot Studio. This feature will reach general availability on December 3, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature, the Agent node can now return files that the agent generates, such as PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CSV, as workflow outputs. Key functionality of this feature includes: Ability to work with both inline agents and existing (published) agents. Generated files appear as an ordere...

item.title: MC1551122: Power Platform - Information regarding the end of support for SharePoint temporary authentication URLs
item.description: Starting April 1, 2027, SharePoint temporary authentication URLs will no longer be available. Power Apps and Automate functionality that relies on these URLs will break when they are retired. How does this affect me? Any Power Apps app or Power Automate cloud flow that relies upon the temporary authentication URLs will stop working. What action do I need to take? If you are using only native controls, actions, and connectors, and as long as you are not providing pre-authenticated URLs from Share...

item.title: MC1560996: Copilot Studio - Create Dataverse agent users with Microsoft Entra agent 's user account
item.description: We are announcing the ability to create Dataverse agent users with Microsoft Entra agent's user account in Copilot Studio. This feature will reach general availability on December 8th, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables you to securely deploy agents to access and interact with Dataverse data by using enterprise-managed Microsoft Entra agent identities. It enables agents to be provisioned as Dataverse agent users with dedicated, least-privileged security roles based on their inte...

item.title: MC1560951: Low-latency alerts and metrics in Monitor
item.description: We are announcing the ability to evaluate alert rules and review supported metrics for business-critical resources every hour in Monitor, helping admins identify potential issues sooner. This feature will enter public preview on November 23, 2026. How does this affect me? When creating or editing an alert rule for a supported app, flow, or agent, admins can set the Data review period to 1 hour. Monitor will evaluate the selected metric after new hourly data becomes available, and the alert can t...

item.title: MC1560957: Power Platform Monitor - Route alert notifications to connector-backed destinations
item.description: We are announcing the ability to route Power Platform Monitor alert notifications to Microsoft Teams, SMS, work item tracking systems, and other connector-backed destinations in Power Platform. This feature will reach public preview on November 20, 2026. How does this affect me? Tenant admins can use the new When an alert fires trigger in the Power Platform for Admins V2 connector to create a Power Automate cloud flow that runs when an opted-in Monitor alert fires. The flow can send alert detail...

item.title: MC1518034: Clipchamp/ Copilot 'Create a video' experience is going to have an admin control available
item.description: Microsoft Clipchamp is adding an admin policy control to manage user access to the AI video creation feature, defaulting to disabled. The feature is now only available from Clipchamp Home. Rollout begins late November 2026, with no action needed to keep the feature disabled.

item.title: MC1560929: Updates to Workforce Insights Agent (Frontier) for Admins in Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Workforce Insights Agent (Frontier) adds a workspace for admins to configure organizational data and context, improving AI-driven responses. Rolling out mid-November 2026 for Frontier tenants, it requires specific admin roles and licensing, with controls for data access, configuration, and compliance.

item.title: MC1560924: Microsoft Teams: Tenant policy controls who can record and transcribe
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a tenant policy controlling who can record and transcribe meetings, allowing admins to set permissions for organizers, co-organizers, and presenters with options to lock or allow changes. Rollout begins December 2026, with no action required unless restricting presenter recording is needed.

item.title: MC1560923: Enhanced prompt categories for Microsoft 365 Copilot in Microsoft Copilot Dashboard and Agent 365 Business Analytics
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces 13 enhanced prompt categories replacing four legacy ones in the Copilot Dashboard and Agent 365 Business Analytics. This update, rolling out worldwide in December 2026, offers detailed insights into Copilot Chat usage by licensed users, with no admin action needed.

item.title: MC1560922: Microsoft Copilot: In-app browsing will be enabled by default in the desktop app
item.description: Microsoft Copilot desktop app will enable in-app browsing by default starting January 2027, allowing users to open websites shared in chat within the app alongside conversations. No action is needed unless organizations want to disable or manage this feature via policies.

item.title: MC1560919: Microsoft Teams mobile: Updated app bar and More menu on iOS and iPadOS
item.description: Microsoft Teams for iOS/iPadOS will update the app bar and More menu to align with iOS 26 design, showing four apps plus a categorized More menu. Rollout is from December 10-16, 2026. Users can reorder and pin apps; no apps are removed. No action required.

item.title: MC1560916: Microsoft Copilot: GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra rolling out
item.description: Microsoft Copilot is expanding AI model options with GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra, rolling out across Cowork, Copilot Studio, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Chat. Astra requires enabling the OpenAI subprocessor. Users with appropriate licenses and configurations get default access; no action is needed but reviewing settings and guidance is recommended.

item.title: MC1532253: Enhanced Copilot and AI controls for meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams is replacing the Copilot meeting policy with two policies—MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI—for clearer control over AI and transcription in meetings. New meeting options provide granular management of AI use. Rollout begins December 2026; existing settings will be automatically mapped with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1551151: Microsoft Entra ID: Risk-based anti-bot verification (CAPTCHA) for SMS and voice multi-factor authentication
item.description: Starting mid-November 2026, Microsoft Entra ID will add risk-based CAPTCHA verification for SMS and voice MFA to prevent automated fraud. Some users may need to complete CAPTCHA before receiving codes or calls. Organizations should prepare help desks, notify users, and ensure network readiness, while continuing to adopt phishing-resistant methods.

item.title: MC1560705: The November 2026 Windows non-security preview update is now available
item.description: The November 2026 non-security preview update is now available for Windows 11, versions 26H2, 26H1, and 25H2. Information about the contents of this update is available in the release notes, which are accessible from the Windows 11 update history page. To learn more about the different types of monthly quality updates, see Understanding Windows monthly updates. Highlights for the Windows 11, version 26H2 update:Windows Search has a streamlined design with a single results list, file previews, an...

item.title: MC1448373: Teams device management transition from Teams admin center to Teams Rooms Pro management portal
item.description: Teams device management in the Teams Admin Center (TAC) will be deprecated by November 2026, transitioning to the Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal (PMP). Admins must complete migration steps, update device software, and ensure devices meet prerequisites to avoid management disruptions. The rollout varies by device type and cloud environment.

item.title: MC1479503: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: Permission changes for select App Governance Entra roles
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps is updating App Governance permissions for select Microsoft Entra roles with Unified RBAC support, rolling out December 2026. Cloud App Security Administrators gain policy management rights; Compliance Administrators and Compliance Data Administrators lose some permissions. Admins should review and update role assignments accordingly.

item.title: MC1560402: Copilot Studio – Use the Decision model in the Classify node in Workflows

Rolling out worldwide mid to late November 2026. No action required; verify browser enablement and governance settings.

item.title: MC1536065: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Suggestions to continue in another Copilot experience
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot will suggest switching to a better-fit Copilot mode (e.g., Cowork) after a user’s chat prompt, maintaining conversation context. Rollout starts mid-November 2026 for Standard and mid-December 2026 for Deferred audiences. No admin action is required; inform users accordingly.

item.title: MC1387578: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Localized default mark and notify email template
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will localize the default "Mark and notify" email template based on users' Outlook language settings, improving clarity in user-reported message notifications. Rollout starts June 2026 globally, with no changes to message classification or custom templates. No action is required.

item.title: MC1509796: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced channel meeting experience
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enhance channel meetings, allowing scheduling from Teams calendar and Outlook, easier discovery for channel members, and delegate scheduling. Rollout starts November 2026, completing by September 2027 across environments. No admin action needed; informing users is recommended. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: MC1409304: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator proactively detects and resolves knowledge gaps in meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams introduces Facilitator, an AI feature that detects and resolves knowledge gaps in meetings by providing relevant answers via web search in the chat. Available from February 2027, it requires Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) and must be manually enabled. Admin controls and user opt-out are supported.

item.title: MC1550533: Scheduled prompts in Microsoft 365 Copilot are moving to native Copilot scheduling and the Tasks view
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot is moving scheduled prompts from Power Platform to native Copilot scheduling, enabling automatic execution of one-time or recurring tasks within Microsoft 365 compliance boundaries. The Power Platform-based experience retires December 31, 2026. Users manage tasks via the Copilot app's Tasks > Scheduled view.

item.title: MC1470885: M365 Copilot: Tell Copilot what you need directly from the Copilot button in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot now features a prompt input directly on the Copilot button in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, enabling faster, contextual content creation without leaving the workflow. Rolling out worldwide from September to December 2026 on Windows, macOS, and web, it requires no admin action but updates to training and documentation.

item.title: MC1529467: Microsoft Windows: Updates to address compromised eMudhra certificate authority keys
item.description: Microsoft will release updates by November 16, 2026, to remove trust for compromised eMudhra certificate authorities in Windows, Edge, and WebView2. Organizations must allow automatic updates, manage disconnected devices, and replace affected certificates to maintain security. Updates block affected CAs and remove related certificates from trust lists.

item.title: MC1546430: 'Add explainer video' Skill in PPT Copilot
item.description: The rollout of the "Add explainer video" skill in PowerPoint Copilot is paused. This feature converts static slides into animated explainer videos for Frontier users on desktop, Mac, and web. No admin action or compliance concerns are required. Updates will be shared via Message center.

item.title: MC1548047: Microsoft Copilot Chat: New Study and Learn-only mode for Education
item.description: Microsoft is introducing an IT-admin-controlled Study and Learn-only mode for Copilot Chat in education, launching mid-November 2026. This mode limits students to the Study and Learn agent, preserving productive struggle. It affects Starter Education license students and requires no action but can be enabled by admins via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

item.title: MC1492151: New Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service experiences across Teams, Copilot, and Outlook
item.description: Microsoft is releasing new Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service experiences integrated into Teams, Copilot, and Outlook to enhance collaboration and customer data access. Key features include Sales and Service skills, Teams Channel Agent, and Sales Development Agent, with phased rollouts starting October 2026 and administrative controls required.

item.description: We are announcing improvements to the experience of setting up connections in chats with Copilot Studio agents. These improvements will reach general availability by December 31, 2026. How does this affect me? item.title: MC1548004: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: Filter responses by content source
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat now lets users filter responses by selecting specific content sources, ensuring answers are grounded only in chosen data while respecting permissions. This feature, enabled by default for licensed users, rolls out worldwide in mid-November 2026 with no required action but recommends reviewing connector names and permissions.

item.title: MC1488841: Microsoft Outlook: Update to default blocked file types in OwaMailboxPolicy
item.description: Microsoft is updating Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows to block .msix and .msixbundle file types by default in OwaMailboxPolicy starting December 2026 to enhance security. Organizations using these file types should allow them in policies before rollout; no action needed otherwise.

item.title: MC1530611: Office in Copilot brings the full power of Office into the Microsoft Copilot app
item.description: Office in Copilot now integrates full Word, Excel, and PowerPoint capabilities within the Microsoft Copilot app, enabling creation, editing, and collaboration without leaving the app. Rollout completes by mid-November 2026. No admin action is required, but admins should inform users and review policies. Data access and AI capabilities are expanded.

item.description: Today, November 10, 2026, Windows 11, version 23H2 Enterprise and Education editions have reached end of updates. The November 2026 Windows security update is the last update available for these editions. After this date, devices running these editions will no longer receive monthly security updates containing protections from the latest security threats. item.description: The November 2026 security update is now available for all supported versions of Windows. We recommend that you install these updates promptly. item.title: MC1381121: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Policy sync and device health AI skill
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention introduces AI-powered Policy Sync and Device Health skills for real-time visibility into policy deployment and sync issues. Rolling out mid-2027, it helps admins identify impacted devices, root causes, and remediation actions, requiring Security Copilot enabled in the tenant.

item.title: MC1465768: Microsoft Teams: Users can temporarily pause all notifications
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow users to temporarily pause notifications for a chosen duration to reduce interruptions and improve focus. This feature, available on desktop, web, and mobile, rolls out globally from mid-September to November 2026. No admin action is needed; users can enable it via their profile menu.

item.title: MC1526651: Microsoft Teams: Malicious QR code detection in messages
item.description: Microsoft Teams will detect malicious QR codes in messages starting mid-November 2026, warning users of harmful links. Detection applies to chats and channels, with external QR codes blurred by default. The feature is enabled via existing Malicious URL protection, requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1537353: Microsoft Teams: Invite attendees to register
item.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding the "Invite to register" feature for events, allowing organizers to email registration links. Rolling out worldwide by late November 2026. No special preparation needed, but configuring a custom domain for M365 notifications is recommended to avoid restrictions. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: MC1508234: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription options align with admin policies
item.description: Microsoft Teams will update meeting options to show automatic recording and transcription settings based on assigned policies, adding a new "Record only" option. Rollout starts mid-November 2026, completing by mid-December. No admin action is needed; organizers see only options allowed by their policies.

item.title: MC1546438: Action may be required: Claude models in Copilot are coming into the EU Data Boundary and will be enabled by default
item.description: Starting December 9, 2026, Claude models in Microsoft Copilot will be enabled by default for eligible EU and EFTA tenants, with data processing moved into the EU Data Boundary. Admins can opt out or limit access before that date via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

item.title: MC1546447: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Updated recipient inclusion logic for threat protection policies
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will change recipient inclusion logic in threat protection policies from Match all (AND) to Match any (OR) when multiple recipient types are specified. This update, rolling out in December 2026, expands policy scope upon modification but does not auto-convert existing policies.

item.title: MC1546429: Power BI retiring standalone Copilot experiences (preview)
item.description: Power BI will retire the standalone Copilot preview in January 2027, replacing it with Microsoft 365 Copilot enabled by default from December 8, 2026. Standalone Copilot access and settings will be removed; organizations should prepare for this transition and notify users accordingly.

item.title: MC1546411: Retirement of Viva Insights (personal insights) and Viva Learning usage reports
item.description: Viva Insights personal insights and Viva Learning usage reports will be retired from the Microsoft 365 admin center by mid-November 2026. Viva Learning analytics remain accessible within the Viva Learning app. Admins should update documentation and inform reporting administrators of this change.

item.title: MC1546409: Microsoft Teams: Retirement of off-network invitations to Teams Free
item.description: Microsoft Teams will retire off-network invitations for Teams Free accounts starting December 2026. Users can no longer invite external people via email or chat links to create Teams Free accounts. Existing Teams Free collaboration and federation remain unchanged. No admin action is needed, but user guidance should be updated.

item.title: MC1479277: Microsoft Copilot: New ways to work across Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft 365
item.description: Microsoft Copilot updates include a new Home experience, enhanced Office integration, Code and Autopilot features with usage-based billing, Copilot Managed Runtime for enterprise code, and general availability in SharePoint and OneDrive. Admins must configure spending policies and manage access via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

item.title: MC1546354: Discover usage-based billing (UBB) experiences like Cowork, Code, and Autopilot
item.description: Usage-based billing experiences like Cowork, Code, and Autopilot will be visible by default to Microsoft 365 Copilot licensed users starting January 2027. New admin controls will allow organizations to manage access requests and provide custom guidance URLs. Existing spending policies still govern actual usage and billing.

item.title: MC1506730: Classic Outlook for Windows: Upcoming visual improvements and a more consistent Outlook experience
item.description: Classic Outlook for Windows will receive visual updates—icons, spacing, and alignment—for improved clarity and consistency starting mid-November 2026. A nonintrusive "What’s New" dialog will inform users monthly. No admin action is needed; these changes do not alter workflows or replace the classic experience.

item.title: MC1546312: Power Platform admin center - Connector inventory in Power Platform inventory
item.description: We are announcing Connector inventory in Power Platform inventory. This feature will reach general availability by November 10, 2026. How does this affect me? item.title: MC1330893: Pay-as-you-go consumption-based meter for your extra SharePoint storage needs
item.description: Microsoft is introducing a pay-as-you-go billing model for SharePoint storage overages, allowing admins to pay only for extra storage used beyond the included quota. This opt-in feature, rolling out globally in January 2027, integrates with Microsoft 365 Archive and requires Azure billing permissions.

item.title: MC1473155: Microsoft Purview: permissions audit log improvements
item.description: Microsoft Purview is enhancing audit logging for role-based access control, adding two new audit operations to improve transparency and troubleshooting. The update, rolling out worldwide from late September to mid-November 2026, requires no action but helps administrators better investigate access issues and monitor compliance.

item.title: MC1478975: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Use Microsoft Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents
item.description: Microsoft 365 now supports Microsoft Agent 365 agents using the Agent2Agent protocol as connected agents in declarative agents, expanding integration options. Administrators manage and approve these agents via the Microsoft 365 admin center. Rollout began in August 2026 and completes by December 2026, enabling enhanced AI interactions and workflows.

item.title: MC1509799: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Legal plugins in Word and Cowork
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces legal plugins in Word and Cowork to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline documents using Microsoft 365 context and third-party sources. Rollout occurs from April to December 2026. Admins can enable or disable these plugins; no setup is required.

item.title: MC1146821: Rewrite with Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat coming soon to Edge for Business users
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat’s Writing Assistance will roll out in Edge for Business by late January 2027, enabled by default. Users can access it via right-click on editable text. Admins can control it with the InlineComposeEnabled policy. DLP policies may restrict its functionality on certain content.

item.title: MC1545696: Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint: Annotate sensitivity-label protected PDFs on the web
item.description: OneDrive and SharePoint on the web will allow users with editing rights to annotate sensitivity-label protected PDFs without removing labels. Annotations and protections are preserved upon saving. This feature rolls out worldwide in late January 2027, requires no admin action, and applies only to OneDrive for Business and SharePoint.

item.title: MC1545695: App Blocks in M365 Copilot
item.description: App Blocks in M365 Copilot enables interactive apps like calculators and dashboards within Copilot Chat conversations, enhancing user experience without leaving the chat. It rolls out worldwide from late October to early November 2026, affecting Microsoft 365 Copilot users, with no action or compliance issues required.

item.title: MC1545691: Microsoft Purview: Retirement of select DSPM partner integrations
item.description: Microsoft Purview will retire select DSPM partner integrations (Varonis, BigID, Cyera, OneTrust) for non-Microsoft data sources on December 7, 2026. These integrations will no longer ingest or display data, but other DSPM capabilities remain unaffected. No action is required, but review dependencies if using these integrations.

item.title: MC1480869: Microsoft 365 settings enabled by default for newly created Engage communities
item.description: Newly created Microsoft Viva Engage communities will have Microsoft 365 group settings enabled by default, subscribing members to community emails and calendar invites. Rollout completes by November 2026. Community owners can adjust settings via the My Account portal. No admin action is required. Existing communities update later this fall.

item.title: MC1492166: Microsoft Outlook: New event duplication capability
item.description: Microsoft Outlook is adding a "Duplicate event" feature, allowing users to quickly create new events based on existing ones without re-entering details. The rollout began in late September 2026 and will complete by early December 2026. No action or compliance changes are required.

item.title: MC1301714: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention- DLP to restrict processing external emails in M365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
item.description: Microsoft Purview is expanding Data Loss Prevention (DLP) to restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing emails from external or untrusted domains. This new admin-configurable DLP control, rolling out in public preview June 2026 and general availability June 2027, excludes external emails from Copilot grounding while maintaining internal data use.

item.title: MC1542066: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Changes to custom organizational data in MODS for Workforce Insights
item.description: Microsoft 365 is retiring the Workforce Insights endpoint in MODS by November 18, 2026. Custom organizational data will now be ingested via the Microsoft 365 profile endpoint. Organizations using non-public attributes must join a private preview and switch before the deadline to continue data uploads.

item.title: MC1542062: Copilot Cowork: Power Platform connectors now follow Microsoft 365 admin center settings
item.description: Microsoft Copilot Cowork now supports Power Platform connectors managed via the Microsoft 365 admin center, allowing centralized control over connector use with third-party apps. Rollout completes by mid-November 2026. Admins should review and configure connector availability, noting that Power Platform DLP policies do not apply to Cowork.

item.title: MC1519843: New Outlook for Windows: All Accounts view brings email into a single inbox view
item.description: The new Outlook for Windows offers an All Accounts (Unified Inbox) view, letting users see and manage emails from multiple accounts in one inbox without merging mailboxes. Admins can control this feature via a policy in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center, enabling or disabling it and user override options.

item.title: MC1193692: Microsoft 365: Enrich profile cards with custom properties from third-party systems
item.description: Starting January 2027, Microsoft 365 admins can add up to 10 custom properties from external systems to profile cards via Microsoft Graph People connectors. This feature is off by default, requires admin setup, and enhances user profiles for better collaboration. Future updates will support SAP SuccessFactors and Workday.

item.title: MC1230889: Outlook for Windows report retirement in the Exchange admin center
item.description: The Outlook for Windows Usage Report in the Exchange admin center will retire in early April 2027. Admins must use the Microsoft 365 admin center for Outlook usage data. No user impact or admin action is needed, but update any documentation referencing the retired report.

item.title: MC1405506: Microsoft OneNote: Multimodal recording in Copilot Notebooks on Windows
item.description: Microsoft is introducing multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks on Windows, enabling users to record audio, images, and notes together. Microsoft 365 Copilot then generates structured insights like summaries and action items. The feature rolls out worldwide by end of November 2026, requires a Copilot license, and can be disabled by admins.

item.title: MC1307979: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot chat pane and Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (iPhone)
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces a new chat pane and Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (iPhone) for users with Copilot (Premium) licenses, enabling AI-generated summaries and note interaction. Rollout begins end of November 2026, with existing Copilot policies applying and no admin action required before deployment.

item.title: MC1309746: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot chat pane and Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (Android)
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces a new Copilot chat pane and Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (Android) for users with Premium licenses, enabling AI-generated summaries and Q&A on notes. Rollout begins end of November 2026, with existing Copilot policies applying and no admin action required before deployment.

item.title: MC1521609: Create sales pitches with Copilot in PowerPoint
item.description: A new Copilot skill in PowerPoint helps users create structured sales pitch presentations for various customer scenarios. It rolls out worldwide from late October to late November 2026 on Win32, Mac, and Web. No admin action or compliance concerns are required.

item.title: MC1540526: Microsoft Online Services Subprocessor Disclosure Update
item.description: A Data Privacy message regarding your organization is available within Message Center. The contents of this message can be accessed within Message Center by a Global Administrator or someone designated as a Message Center Privacy Reader. Please sign in to Admin Center to view the details of this message in the M365 Message center.

item.title: MC1540513: Microsoft SharePoint Online and OneDrive for the web: Updated search experience with Copilot Search
item.description: SharePoint Online and OneDrive on the web are updating to a unified Copilot Search experience with natural-language prompts, AI summaries, and filters. Rollout starts mid-October 2026 (preview) and mid-January 2027 (general). Users can opt out during preview; minimal action required from organizations.

item.title: MC1269864: Microsoft Teams: New chat sections for muted and meeting chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce two new chat sections—Muted chats (enabled by default) and Meeting chats (disabled by default)—to organize conversations. Rollout begins January 2027. Users can enable/disable and reorder these sections; no admin action is needed. Muted chats move automatically to their section unless favorited.

item.title: MC1540349: Microsoft Teams: Decline incoming mobile calls with a message
item.description: Microsoft Teams mobile users will soon be able to decline incoming calls with a predefined or custom message sent via Teams chat. This feature, rolling out worldwide in December 2026, enhances communication without answering calls. It applies only to Teams-to-Teams calls with available chat and requires no admin action.

item.title: MC1540348: Microsoft SharePoint: Data access governance report for group permissions
item.description: Microsoft SharePoint is introducing a Data access governance report in the admin center to help administrators identify sites accessible to specific groups and assess access levels. Rolling out worldwide from late November to early December 2026, it aids in managing permissions and preventing unintended content exposure.

item.title: MC1540345: Action required: Update permissions for Exchange Online Admin API
item.description: Microsoft is updating Exchange Online Admin API v2.0 permissions, replacing Exchange.ManageV2 and Exchange.ManageAsAppV2 with new permissions by November 2026. Affected applications must transition, obtain admin consent, verify RBAC roles, test, and remove old permissions to maintain access. No endpoint changes occur.

item.title: MC1540342: Action required: Exchange Online Admin API MailboxFolderPermission response update
item.description: Microsoft will update the Exchange Online Admin API v2.0 MailboxFolderPermission endpoint to return the User property as a structured object with DisplayName, Name, and PrimarySmtpAddress by early November 2026. Organizations must update applications to handle this change to avoid errors.

item.title: MC1540339: Microsoft Planner: Planner capabilities in Copilot Cowork through the Planner Plugin
item.description: The Planner Plugin integrates Microsoft Planner with Copilot Cowork, enabling task prioritization, completion assistance, plan creation, visual reporting, and cross-Microsoft 365 work using Planner data. It rolls out worldwide by November 2026, requires appropriate licenses, and offers admin and user controls for availability and use.

item.title: MC1540330: Opal (Frontier) - UBB Notification
item.description: Opal (Frontier) is a Microsoft 365 Computer Use Agent requiring admin-controlled access and usage-based billing for Copilot Credits. item.title: MC1523084: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Move email messages to quarantine with a new remediation action
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 introduces a "Move to Quarantine" remediation action, allowing admins to move suspicious emails from user mailboxes to Defender quarantine for safer investigation and management. Rollout begins late November 2026, with no action required but policy and role reviews recommended.

item.title: MC1539004: Work IQ expands memory capabilities to agents
item.description: Work IQ introduces a new MCP path, /memory/me/coreMemories, giving authorized agents read-only access to a user's personalized memory profile, including Custom Instructions, Saved Memories, and chat history insights. Rolling out globally in December 2026, access is controlled by default-enabled admin policies and respects user personalization settings.

item.title: MC1539003: Microsoft Viva Engage: Improved shared message experience
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage will enhance shared messages with richer previews including formatted text, images, videos, and attachments. Users can view and interact with full conversations on the web without losing their feed position. Rollout starts mid-November 2026, requiring no workflow changes but user communication is recommended.

item.title: MC1539002: Microsoft Copilot Chat: Planner Agent task assignment, catch-up, and Copilot memory integration
item.description: Microsoft Copilot Chat's Planner Agent is enhanced with task assignment, scheduled task catch-up, and memory integration to improve task management and personalized responses. Rolling out worldwide in December 2026, it supports shared basic plans, larger plans, and offers improved speed, reliability, and user control without admin action needed.

item.title: MC1539001: Microsoft 365 admin center: Project usage report retirement
item.description: The Project usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center will be retired on December 4, 2026, due to the retirement of Project Online and Project for the web. Administrators should export needed data by November 20, 2026, and use the Planner usage report instead. The Project desktop client remains supported.

item.title: MC1539000: Microsoft Outlook: Search within a selected folder

item.description: OneDrive for the web will adopt the modern SharePoint document library experience, featuring improved navigation and enhanced filtering across views. Rollout begins mid-August 2026, completing by late October. Changes are enabled by default, with no impact on permissions or policies; no user action required.

item.title: MC1288531: Microsoft Viva - Copilot Analytics: Export agent data from the Agent Dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Viva will add a new export feature in the Agent Dashboard by mid-November 2026, allowing eligible users with at least 50 Copilot licenses to download de-identified Copilot agent usage data for up to six months. Admins can manage or disable this feature via Viva Feature Access Management.

item.title: MC1461165: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator can join channel meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow adding Facilitator to channel meetings starting early February 2027, enabling note-taking, agenda management, Q&A, and task management. The rollout is delayed from November 2026, requires no action, and affects organizations with Facilitator enabled and licensed users.

item.title: MC1483419: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Let representatives set next presence to handle routing of work items
item.description: We are announcing the ability to allow representatives to set next presence to indicate their future availability in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on October 30, 2026. How does this affect me? Next presence allows service representatives to queue their next availability status and stop receiving new assignments while the next presence status is pending. item.title: MC1515939: Sending from Aliases
item.description: Sending from Aliases is now generally available in Exchange Online, allowing users to send emails from any mailbox alias. Admins can enable it via PowerShell or Exchange Admin Center. Additional features are being explored, and no compliance issues have been identified.

item.title: MC1515932: External Recipients Banner on Outlook Mobile
item.description: Outlook Mobile will display a banner warning when external attendees are added to meetings, rolling out worldwide from late October to late November 2026. This helps prevent accidental sharing with external recipients. No action or compliance changes are required.

item.title: MC1515931: Microsoft Teams: Simplified app enablement experience in Teams admin center
item.description: Microsoft is launching a simplified app enablement experience in the Teams admin center by mid-October 2026. It offers a guided flow for managing app access, installation, and permissions, reducing steps for admins. Existing settings remain unchanged until admins apply updates. No prior action is needed.

item.title: MC1515930: Cowork browser use setting renamed to Browser use in Microsoft Copilot
item.description: The Cowork settings panel in Microsoft Copilot is renamed to Browser use in Microsoft Copilot to improve discoverability. This change, rolling out in mid-October 2026, does not affect functionality or configurations. No action is required; admins will find the setting under the new name.

item.title: MC1515929: Microsoft Teams: GitHub app consolidation and legacy GitHub app deprecation
item.description: Microsoft Teams is consolidating GitHub Notifications and GitHub Copilot into a single GitHub app, deprecating the legacy app by November 16, 2026. Users must update or replace the old apps with the new GitHub app, which integrates repository updates and Copilot features. Admins should manage app access and update policies accordingly.

item.title: MC1515927: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Critique and Council preview experiences will retire
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Critique and Council preview experiences in Researcher will retire between late October and mid-November 2026. These features will no longer be accessible, but Researcher and Analyst remain available. Organizations should inform users, update guidance, and notify help desks accordingly. No compliance issues noted.

item.title: MC1515917: Database Hub in Fabric: Default enablement and admin opt-out
item.description: Microsoft Fabric will enable Database Hub by default on November 17, 2026, allowing authorized users to access database insights without admin activation. Admins can opt out via the Fabric admin portal. No databases or permissions change, and usage remains subject to existing roles and licensing.

item.title: MC1469565: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Graph API Support for archive mailboxes
item.description: Microsoft is retiring Exchange Web Services (EWS) in Exchange Online by April 2027 and expanding Microsoft Graph API support for archive mailboxes. Organizations must migrate applications from EWS to Microsoft Graph APIs by October 2026 to maintain archive mailbox access, compliance, eDiscovery, and data lifecycle management.

item.title: MC1302905: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Purview SDK embedded in Agent Framework SDK
item.description: Microsoft has paused the rollout of integrating the Microsoft Purview SDK into the Agent Framework SDK, which enables AI agents to enforce Purview compliance and data protection. This integration requires developer implementation and affects organizations building AI agents with Purview licenses. No immediate admin action is needed if not developing AI agents.

item.title: MC1473153: Microsoft Teams: New centralized experience for organizing important resources in chats and channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a centralized resource management experience in chats and channels, allowing users to pin and organize resources below headers and access them on mobile. The "In this chat" and "In this channel" panes will be removed. Rollout occurs from late September to mid-November 2026.

item.title: MC1388719: Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification settings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce granular channel notification presets—All new messages, Mentions and replies, and Mute—with further customization options. Rollout occurs from October to December 2026 across environments. The feature is enabled by default, requires no admin changes, and aims to improve notification control and reduce noise.

item.title: MC1506727: Microsoft Agent 365: Expanded access to Microsoft agent usage and activity insights in Microsoft 365 admin center
item.description: Starting late October 2026, Microsoft 365 admin center will expand access to usage and activity insights for Microsoft-built or platform-based agents, regardless of Agent 365 licensing. This provides foundational visibility into agent metrics, while full management features still require paid licenses. Rollout completes by late November 2026.

item.title: MC1515270: Quick machine recovery is now supported on Windows Server 2025
item.description: What and why:With the October 2026 Windows security update, Quick machine recovery is now available for Windows Server 2025. Quick machine recovery can help servers recover from critical boot failures by using Windows Recovery Environment (WinRE) to search Windows Update for an applicable remediation. Recovery is dependent on an applicable remediation being available. On Windows Server 2025, quick machine recovery is disabled by default. Administrators can use Group Policy to enable and configur...

item.title: MC1404326: Microsoft 365 admin center: New usage report for Copilot connectors
item.description: Microsoft 365 will introduce a new Copilot connectors usage report in the admin center by November 2026, showing usage across Copilot Chat, Search, and agents. It requires a Copilot (Premium) license, is enabled by default, and helps admins track adoption without impacting user workflows.

item.title: MC1411727: Copilot Notebooks: Suggested artifacts for faster content creation
item.description: Copilot Notebooks will proactively suggest relevant Word, Excel, and PowerPoint artifacts based on notebook content and Microsoft 365 context, speeding content creation. Available by default to eligible users from early July 2026 (preview) and late August 2026 (general availability). No admin action required; future support for PDFs and Pages planned.

item.title: MC1511072: Microsoft Teams: Upcoming change to voicemail message delivery by email
item.description: Microsoft Teams will change voicemail email delivery by early March 2027, moving caller info from the email From field to the Subject line and allowing organizations to use their own domains for sending. Organizations should update mail-flow rules accordingly; no new compliance requirements arise.

item.title: MC1511071: Action required: Review property changes for Exchange Online scenarios
item.description: Exchange Online is deprecating certain properties in Get-Mailbox -Migration and New-Mailbox -Migration cmdlets starting November 15, 2026. Organizations must review and update scripts or workflows using these properties before then to avoid disruptions. Full details and guidance are provided in the linked Microsoft documentation.

item.title: MC1511056: Microsoft Copilot Studio – Teams app retirement
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the Copilot Studio app in Teams by February 2027, transitioning all chatbot agent creation and management to the Copilot Studio web app. Editing in Teams ends January 2027. Users and admins should switch to the web app and update related documentation accordingly.

item.title: MC1511052: Upcoming changes to Agents in SharePoint and OneDrive
item.description: SharePoint and OneDrive agents using the .agent file format will be upgraded to integrate with Microsoft Copilot’s extensibility ecosystem. From mid-November 2026, new agents use the Copilot Agent Builder, with .agent files supported until March 2027, after which they stop working. Organizations should prepare to upgrade agents and adopt new management and governance tools.

item.title: MC1509805: Microsoft Copilot: Additional content safety protections for students under 18
item.description: Microsoft Copilot will automatically enable additional content safety protections for users aged 13-17, identified by the teen ageGroup in Entra ID, starting mid-October 2026. This ensures a safer, age-appropriate experience with no required configuration changes. Organizations should inform users and update documentation accordingly.

item.title: MC1509800: Microsoft Outlook for Android: Multi-select and bulk actions in search results
item.description: Microsoft Outlook for Android will add multi-select and bulk actions in search results starting mid-October 2026, allowing users to manage multiple emails at once. This feature, already on iOS, improves efficiency without requiring admin action; users should be informed and keep the app updated.

item.title: MC1509797: Support for Office LTSC 2021 and additional apps ended on October 13, 2026
item.description: Support for Office LTSC 2021 and related apps ended on October 13, 2026, with no more security updates or support. Organizations should upgrade to Microsoft 365 Apps or Office LTSC 2024 to maintain security, compliance, and support. Admins must identify and update affected devices promptly.

item.title: MC1509789: Microsoft Edge: Browser-native XSLT will be disabled by default
item.description: Microsoft Edge will disable browser-native XSLT by default starting mid-December 2026 to reduce security risks. Organizations should identify and migrate affected applications before Edge Stable 159. A temporary XSLTEnabled policy will be available but removed by Edge 176 in Summer 2027.

item.title: MC1509780: Intune ending support for Windows MDM-only enrollment CNAME auto-discovery
item.description: Starting January 15, 2027, Intune will end support for DNS CNAME auto-discovery in Windows MDM-only enrollment. Organizations using this must have users manually enter the Microsoft enrollment server URL. Existing devices and other enrollment methods remain unaffected. Update enrollment procedures accordingly.

item.title: MC1419798: Microsoft Teams Rooms: Identify in-room participants with IntelliFrame people labels
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will introduce IntelliFrame people labels by late January 2027, automatically displaying enrolled in-room participants’ names and contact cards to remote attendees, enhancing hybrid meeting clarity. The feature requires Teams Rooms Pro licenses, voice and face recognition enrollment, and can be managed via Teams meeting policies.

item.title: MC1474110: Microsoft Planner: Capacity view
item.description: Microsoft Planner's new Capacity view, launching late October 2026, shows a live staffing timeline from existing task data for Plan 3 licensed users on web and desktop (Teams, Outlook). It helps spot workload distribution without extra reports. No admin action needed; users should keep task details updated.

item.title: MC1443514: Microsoft Planner: Planner Agent chat in basic plans
item.description: Planner Agent chat is being added to Microsoft Planner basic plans, enabling users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license to interact via natural language for plan management, insights, and task updates. Rollout begins September 2026, with admin controls to enable or block access.

item.title: MC1155311: Viva Engage: Agents in Viva Engage communities Public Preview
item.description: Viva Engage Community Agents are in public preview, allowing admins to add AI agents that draft answers using community and selected SharePoint content. Features include tagging by members, analytics, and configurable posting modes. General availability and network-wide settings will be announced later; admins can opt in via the Engage admin center.

item.title: MC1462921: Calls popout into a new window on the browser to support multi-tasking and collaboration during a meeting
item.description: Microsoft Teams for Web will introduce a Picture-in-Picture Call Monitor allowing users to manage meetings in a separate window while multitasking in other browser tabs. The rollout starts mid-October 2026 for supported browsers like Edge and Chrome, requiring no admin action but user awareness and supported browser versions.

item.title: MC1479514: Microsoft Teams: Improved file sharing experience in external chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams is enabling default file attachment (paperclip and drag-and-drop) in external chats, storing files in the sender’s OneDrive with automatic permission assignment per existing OneDrive/SharePoint policies. Organizations can opt out via Teams PowerShell. Existing sharing restrictions remain unchanged. User training and policy review are recommended.

item.title: MC1509128: App-V server support extended through October 9, 2029
item.description: What and why:Microsoft is returning Application Virtualization (App-V) server to extended support (as part of the Fixed Lifecycle policy) for an additional three years, through October 9, 2029. This extension gives your organization additional time to continue operating your existing App-V server deployments while evaluating a longer-term application delivery strategy. item.title: MC1173208: Microsoft Copilot Analytics: Data export public preview for Copilot metrics in the Copilot dashboard
item.description: Microsoft is introducing a default-on public preview of a data export feature in the Copilot Dashboard for users with full company-level access. It enables export of de-identified, weekly Copilot usage metrics from the past six months to analyze adoption and optimize licensing. Requires 50+ Copilot licenses.

item.description: Beginning with the October 2026 security update, Windows 11, versions 26H2, 25H2, and 24H2, along with Windows Server 2025 enforce restrictions on generating NTLMv1-derived credentials for Single Sign-On by default.
